name: Monopoly

key_numbers.label: Auction opening bid
key_numbers.value: 10, raised in steps of 1 or more

setup.text: Choose a Banker. They look after the bank's money, Houses, Hotels, Title Deeds and auctions. The Banker may play but keeps personal money apart.
Shuffle the Community Chest cards and place them face down on their board space.
Shuffle the Chance cards and place them face down on their board space.
Put the dice beside the board.
The Banker gives each player a starting stake of 1,500.
Choose a token and place it on GO.
Everyone rolls both dice. The highest roller starts and play passes to the left.

turn.summary: Roll, move clockwise, deal with the space you land on, then pass the dice. Doubles give you another go.
steps: Roll both dice and move your token clockwise that many spaces.

Carry out the space you landed on. Unowned property must be bought or auctioned. Pay rent on owned property when the owner asks. Take a Chance or Community Chest card and obey it, then return it to the bottom.
Rolling doubles earns another roll. A third double in a row sends you straight to Jail without moving.
Pass the dice to your left when your turn ends.
Whenever you have a full colour set you can build Houses, even off your own turn, evenly across the set; after 4 Houses on every street in the set you can upgrade to a Hotel.

end: The game ends when every player but one has gone bankrupt.

scoring.text: There are no points. Be the last player left with money to win.
Go bankrupt if you cannot pay after selling buildings and mortgaging properties. Hand everything to the player you owe, or to the Bank, which then auctions every property.

missed.text: Free Parking pays nothing and nothing happens there. Never put money in the middle of the board.
If you land on unowned property and do not buy it, it must go to auction. All players may bid, with no need to follow turn order.
Rent is only owed if the owner asks before the next player rolls.
You must build evenly and sell evenly, and you cannot build on a street if any street in its set is mortgaged. You cannot sell or trade buildings to other players.
To mortgage a property, first sell every building in its colour set back to the Bank at half price.
To leave Jail, pay 50 at the start of your turn, use a Get Out of Jail Free card, or roll doubles. After three turns of failing, pay 50 and move.
While in Jail you can still collect rent, bid, build, mortgage and trade.
The owner of one utility charges 4 times the dice roll; owning both utilities makes it 10 times.
